steps.heading: Come worship with us just as you are.
steps.body: We are in Suite 618 at 1090 36th St SE. There is no dress code. Some people wear their Sunday best, some come in jeans. At FTH we focus on the heart, not the attire. If you are running late, come anyway. Nobody is counting.

steps.heading: Worship, then the Word.
steps.body: Feel free to stand or sit and worship God in Spirit and truth. Be prepared for a spirit-filled spontaneous worship experience. We will not ask you to stand and introduce yourself. We simply ask you to be open to the Spirit's leading.

steps.heading: No need to rush out.
steps.body: There is usually coffee and conversation afterwards. Stay and meet others and be encouraged through fellowship.
